watches.name: NOCTUA WATCH CORP. ZULU
watches.description: The ultimate in TACTICOOL watches! Discover the ultimate in rugged sophistication with our hand-assembled automatic watches. Crafted for divers, pilots, and watch enthusiasts, each timepiece is built for durability and precision. Experience unmatched quality in every small-batch creation. All Noctua watches are hand assembled in Canada by one person. They are all made in small batches to ensure consistent quality. Each watch undergoes thorough in house testing and inspections before being packaged up for you. All Zulu watches ship in a black Tactical Molle Carrying Bag with a bracelet and a black or olive green silicone strap of your choice. Case Specifications: Case: 316L stainless steel, beadblasted, 42mm, crown at 3 Lug to Lug: 46mm Thickness: 12mm Lug Width: 22mm Crown: 7mm, 316L stainless steel, beablasted, screw-down Bezel: 316L stainless steel, beadblasted, 24h Case back: 316L stainless steel, screw down Chapter ring: Superluminova C3 lumed kanji Crystal: Flat, blue AR-coated sapphire Hands: Superluminova C3 lumed high visibility pilot-style hands Dial: Lumed logo, matte black 3,6,9,12 dial with date at 4:30 Movement: Seiko NH34a GMT automatic, black date wheel, lumed numbers, hacking, hand winding Water resistance: 300m
